## s12-v19 — argument map

Seeing each thing (sarvam), seeing You (tvām): seeing each thing is seeing You. The devotee sees each thing as You. Seeing each thing, seeing You: non-dual seeing.

### Open
- Whether 'sarvam' means 'all things' or 'everything' is unresolved.
- Whether 'tvām' is accusative or dative is unresolved.
